# Gateway fixtures

Raw responses recorded from the public Polymarket US gateway
(`https://gateway.polymarket.us`) on 2026-10-17 between 05:40 and 05:45 UTC.
Event lists were trimmed to BTC/ETH up/down events plus one BTC range event.

**These are test fixtures only.** They must never be shown as live data. Code
that loads them tags every record `source="fixture"`.
